messages:
mara: heads up — after today's installer I can't get `redwoodctl local-test start` to bind on :8989. It exits with EADDRINUSE even though `ss` shows nothing listening.
ashok: what OS + redwoodctl version? can you paste the exact command + short log?
mara: WSL2 Ubuntu 22.04, redwoodctl 0.13.1. Command: `redwoodctl local-test start --port 8989 --config ./rt.yaml`
mara: log snippet: ```2026-03-22T15:03:12Z INFO starting local-test runtime on 0.0.0.0:8989
2026-03-22T15:03:12Z ERROR listen tcp 0.0.0.0:8989: bind: address already in use
2026-03-22T15:03:12Z INFO dumping runtime state -> /tmp/rt-dump.json```
jeff: odd. if ss shows nothing, could be another process transiently opening the port and closing (TIME_WAIT shouldn't block bind though). did you try `lsof -nP -iTCP:8989 -sTCP:LISTEN`?
mara: yep `lsof` shows nothing. I also tried restarting WSL and same result.
lia: mara — are you running any dev helpers (like the auth daemon or a browser helper) that might start a tiny local http server?
mara: hmm i do have the device-code auth flow helper enabled in my env (REDWOOD_AUTH_LOCAL=1). i just nuked that and local-test starts fine.
ashok: aha. that's the clue — the device-code helper launches a tiny local server to receive the callback and its default port is 8989. if that binds before local-test we'll get EADDRINUSE.
jeff: interesting race. both tools default to same port. workaround for now: set `REDWOOD_AUTH_PORT=0` to let the auth helper pick a random free port, or run local-test with `--port` to some other value.
mara: confirmed `REDWOOD_AUTH_PORT=0 redwoodctl local-test start` works. thanks.
ashok: i'll open an issue and push a quick fix: patch the auth helper to try ephemeral port when `--no-interactive` or when `local-test` subcommand detected. also add a quick check in local-test startup to give a friendlier error suggesting auth port clash.
ashok: created github.com/redwood-inference/redwoodctl/pull/5827 — description: "auth helper: avoid fixed 8989 port, prefer ephemeral when used in headless flows"
lia: can we also add a diagnostic message that prints "auth helper bound on 8989" as a DEBUG log so devs can see what's taking the port?
jeff: +1. also add docs note in quickstart about REDWOOD_AUTH_PORT env var. low-effort bandaid but will reduce confusion.
mara: nice. thanks team — saved my afternoon. :tada:
